XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='IHC.ITF.BILLING.DStruc.CBRefundToARM.InCB.Batch' targetClass='IHC.ITF.BILLING.DStruc.CBRefundToARM.OutCB.Body.Record' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Refund Header transformation</annotation> <trace value='"Debug - Header Mapping"' /> <assign value='"HEAD"' property='target.DeptNumber' action='set' /> <assign value='..Pad(source.Header.RecordCount,-11,"0")' property='target.AccountNumber' action='set' /> <trace value='"ebug2 - Header Mapping"' /> <assign value='source.Header.Description' property='target.RefundReason1' action='set' /> <assign value='$EXTRACT(source.Header.Date,5,8)_"-"_$EXTRACT(source.Header.Date,1,2)_"-"_$EXTRACT(source.Header.Date,3,4)' property='target.DateRequested' action='set' /> <trace value='"Debug3 - Header Mapping"' /> <assign value='..Pad(..Piece(source.Header.TotalDollars,"-",2),-9,"0")' property='target.RequestedAmount' action='set' /> <trace value='"Debug - Header Mapping Complete"' /> </transform>
